Seris 0.1.0-beta.1 connects AI strategy creation, user approval, real-market backtesting and result inspection.

### Changes

- Review AI-authored TypeScript strategies before saving. Backtest with closed Binance spot candles and inspect parameters, fills, equity, drawdown and trailing stops.
- Save user strategies in persistent application data. On first launch, recover drafts from older runtime caches without overwriting existing user copies. Legacy indicator imports continue to work after migration.
- Keep backtest results on the selected strategy page, with separate overview, code and documentation tabs.
- Use connection/model-parameter tabs in Settings and compact inline tool-result rows in Chat, with expandable, scrollable and copyable output.
- Correct next-open fills, entry-bar stops, interval-dependent metrics and exclusion of the current unfinished candle.

### Validation

- 67 automated regression tests, TypeScript checks, packaged-runtime validation and native startup/crash-recovery checks.
- Upgrade regression: migrate drafts, remove old runtime caches, reopen and backtest both legacy and newly saved strategies.
- A compiled-client end-to-end run used a configured DeepSeek model and 2,159 real BTCUSDT hourly candles from Binance, including strategy approval, saving, backtesting and result inspection.

### Supported platform and limits

- **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon) only.** Windows, Linux and Intel Mac installers are not provided in this release.
- **Unsigned and not notarized.** macOS may block the first launch; use the system's Open Anyway option for this downloaded app.
- Strategies are local backtests and are not connected to live order execution. Automation and Portfolio pages remain prototypes; tools marked as simulated do not execute real transactions.
- Monitoring and alerts run only while Seris is running. Market-data access depends on the provider and region.

User strategies are stored under `skills/strategies/` in the system application-data directory. Existing conversations, model settings and backtest results remain local.
